units.source_text: 她尴尬地笑了笑，左脸颊上浮起个小酒窝。

en.t: She gave an embarrassed little smile, and a small dimple appeared on her left cheek.

units.source_text: 除了眼睛以外，倒是一张让人觉得可爱的脸蛋儿。

en.t: Apart from her eyes, it was actually a face one might have found charming.

units.source_text: 可那眼睛，也许是患了眼病吧。

en.t: But those eyes perhaps suffered from some eye disease.

units.source_text: 红红的眼角，似乎有些溃烂了，再怎么化妆也遮掩不住。

en.t: The reddened corners of her eyes seemed slightly ulcerated, and no amount of makeup could hide them.
Before going to sleep, she ought to put in some eye medicine...
